articleguidance-specialnewarticle-title: Title of the Special:NewArticle page. Also used as the header title across all steps of the new article flow.
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-title-: Placeholder text for the Wikidata search input field
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-loadin: Loading state message displayed while searching Wikidata
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-checki: Progress indicator message displayed while checking search results against available outlines
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-no-res: Message shown when no Wikidata entities match the search query. Parameters: $1 is the search query text
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-search: Error message shown inline in the search results area when all Wikidata queries fail even after a silent retry. Followed by a 'Try again' button.
Label for the inline button that lets the user manually retry after a search error in the search step.
articleguidance-titleconflict-exists-war:
Plain-text warning shown in the title conflict step when the user types an article title that already exists. Parameters:
* $1 - The article title that already exists
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-edit-e: Button text for navigating to edit the existing article that was found
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-disamb: Heading shown above the subject match cards and the article type outlines list
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-browse: First part of the button text to browse all available article type outlines when the user cannot find what they are looking for in the search results
Second part of the button text to browse all available article type outlines when the user cannot find what they are looking for in the search results
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-skip-g: First part of a subtle option, shown only to experienced editors, to skip Article Guidance. Followed by the link {{msg-mw|articleguidance-specialnewarticle-skip-guidance-link}}.

Link text, shown only to experienced editors, that opens the wiki's default editor for the entered title and bypasses Article Guidance. Preceded by {{msg-mw|articleguidance-specialnewarticle-skip-guidance-prefix}}.
Accessible label (aria-label and tooltip) for the info icon next to the skip-guidance option. The icon links to the Article guidance project page on mediawiki.org, opening in a new tab.
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-langua: Notice shown below search result cards when at least one result displays a label from a fallback language (because the wiki's content language has no label on Wikidata). Not shown when all labels are in the requested language or use the 'mul' language code.
articleguidance-sources-title: Title of the sources step where users add references
articleguidance-sources-subtitle: Default subtitle of the sources step explaining why sources are important (when there are no notability risks that required them before continuing)
articleguidance-sources-subtitle-notabil: Alternative subtitle of the sources step asking the user to add required sources before writing.
articleguidance-sources-url-placeholder: Placeholder text for the URL input field where users paste source URLs
articleguidance-sources-add-source: Button label to submit the URL entered in the source input field
articleguidance-sources-invalid-url: Inline validation error displayed below the input when the entered text is not a valid URL
articleguidance-sources-duplicate: Inline validation error displayed below the input when the URL has already been added
articleguidance-sources-continue: Button text to continue from the sources step to the next step
articleguidance-sources-helper: Helper text displayed below the continue button indicating that adding sources is optional at this stage
articleguidance-sources-helper-required:
Persistent helper text shown below the Continue button when the article type requires sources and none have been added yet. Parameters:
* $1 - The human-readable article type label (e.g., "Animal", "Person")
articleguidance-sources-helper-progress:
Helper text shown below the Continue button indicating how many of the required sources have been added so far. Parameters:
* $1 - The number of sources added so far
* $2 - The minimum number of sources required
articleguidance-sources-unreliable-warni: Title of the warning message shown below the input when a URL from a discouraged domain is entered
Description text for the warning shown when a URL from a discouraged domain is entered
articleguidance-sources-tips-title: Title for the tips accordion in the sources step. Parameter: $1 is the human-readable article type label (e.g., 'Person', 'Book').
articleguidance-sources-tips-content-rec: Title for the list of recommended source types shown in the tips accordion
articleguidance-sources-tips-content-dis: Title for the list of discouraged source types shown in the tips accordion
articleguidance-sources-check-failed: Error message displayed when the source validation API call fails unexpectedly
articleguidance-instructions-guidance-he: Heading for the guidance card shown before the user starts writing
articleguidance-instructions-guidance-in: Introductory sentence below the guidance card heading
articleguidance-instructions-source-guid: Guidance text about having reliable sources, shown at the bottom of the guidance card
articleguidance-instructions-start-writi: Button text to start writing the article in the editor
articleguidance-navigation-back: Button text for the back navigation button
articleguidance-category-note: Shown in the article-guidance tag box on outline pages when a category attribute is set. $1 is a wiki link to the category page that new articles will be added to.
articleguidance-notability-restrictions-: Title of the notability restrictions box shown when the selected article type has notability risk tags.
articleguidance-notability-warning: Warning message shown at the top of the notability step. Explains that new articles of this type are often deleted and encourages contributors to use the listed alternatives.
articleguidance-notability-warning-cross: Warning message shown at the top of the notability step when the crosswiki restriction is active. Explains that the subject is not yet covered on other Wikipedias.
articleguidance-notability-warning-wikid: Warning message shown at the top of the notability step when the wikidata restriction is active. Explains that a Wikidata entry is required for this article type.
articleguidance-notability-warning-draft: Warning message shown at the top of the notability step when the draft restriction is active. Explains that the article will start as a draft.
articleguidance-notability-options-headi: Heading for the list of alternative contribution options shown on the notability step.
articleguidance-notability-option-wikida: Title for the 'Add this subject to Wikidata' contribution option. Only shown when the selected outline has the 'wikidata' notability tag.
Short description for the 'Add this subject to Wikidata' contribution option.
articleguidance-notability-option-sandbo: Title for the 'Start in your sandbox' contribution option. Only shown when the selected outline has the 'draft' notability tag.
Short description for the 'Start in your sandbox' contribution option.
articleguidance-notability-option-learn-: Title for the 'Learn what this wiki looks for in new articles' contribution option. Always shown.
Short description for the 'Learn what this wiki looks for in new articles' contribution option.
articleguidance-notability-tag-wikidata: Description shown for the 'wikidata' notability restriction tag. Explains that the article type requires a linked Wikidata item.
articleguidance-notability-tag-crosswiki: Description shown for the 'crosswiki' notability restriction tag. Warns editors to check for existing coverage on other language wikis.
articleguidance-notability-tag-junior: Description shown for the 'junior' notability restriction tag. Indicates that the notability restrictions for this article type apply to junior (new or inexperienced) editors only.
articleguidance-notability-tag-draft: Description shown for the 'draft' notability restriction tag. Indicates that the article may only be published under the Draft namespace (where available) or as a sub-page of the user's namespace.
articleguidance-notability-tag-sources: Description shown for the 'sources' notability restriction tag. Indicates that the article type requires the user to have provided reliable, community-approved sources before creation is allowed.
articleguidance-notability-tag-draft-loc:
Shown below the draft tag restriction message. Tells the editor the exact page title where their article will be created. Parameters:
* $1 - The full draft title (e.g. "Draft:ArticleTitle" or "User:Username/Drafts/ArticleTitle")
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-no-mat: Standalone helper text shown below the article type list when the user cannot find an appropriate type.
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-missin: Standalone action label for opening a new feedback topic on the "Talk:Article guidance" page to suggest a new type.
articleguidance-tracking-category: Tracking category name for pages that use the article-guidance tag. See [[Special:TrackingCategories]].
articleguidance-tracking-category-desc: Description of the tracking category for pages using article-guidance tags, shown on [[Special:TrackingCategories]].
articleguidance-subjectcovered-title: Header for the step shown when the subject already exists on the wiki.
articleguidance-subjectcovered-descripti: Description for the step shown when the subject already exists on the wiki.
articleguidance-subjectcovered-button: Button label for improving the existing article when the subject already exists.
articleguidance-titleconflict-suggestion: Text preceding the suggested alternative title link in the title conflict step.
articleguidance-titleconflict-continue: Button label to proceed past the title conflict step once the user has chosen a free title.
articleguidance-titleconflict-selected-s: Label shown above the selected Wikidata subject card in the title conflict step.
articleguidance-titleconflict-viewexisti: Button label to view the existing article that has the same title as the one the user entered.
articleguidance-updatetitle-title: Header title of the update-title step, shown when the user opens the title editing screen from the article info area.
articleguidance-updatetitle-button: Label for the primary button that saves the updated article title in the update-title step.
articleguidance-updatetitle-cancel: Label for the secondary button that discards edits and returns to the previous step in the update-title step.
articleguidance-updatetitle-originally-t:
Inline reminder shown in the update-title step when the current title differs from what the user originally typed, because the system auto-updated it on Wikidata item selection. Parameters:
* $1 - The title the user originally typed in the search box
articleguidance-updatetitle-use-original: Label for the inline quiet button shown next to the 'originally typed' reminder in the update-title step. Clicking fills the title input with the original typed title but does not submit.
articleguidance-updatetitle-edit-label: Accessible aria-label for the quiet icon button in the article info area that opens the update-title step. Not visible on screen.
tag-articleguidance: Display name for the 'articleguidance' edit tag shown in recent changes, history, and log pages.
tag-articleguidance-description: Description of the 'articleguidance' edit tag shown on [[Special:Tags]].
tag-articleguidance-helppage: URL of the help page linked from the 'articleguidance' edit tag on [[Special:Tags]] and other tag display contexts. Do not translate the URL; translate the target page instead.
articleguidance-publish-followup-confirm: Heading shown in the post-publish follow-up panel after a user successfully publishes a new article through the Article Guidance workflow.
articleguidance-publish-followup-communi: Message in the post-publish follow-up panel informing the user that the editor community will review their newly published article.
articleguidance-publish-followup-edit-mo: Message for the button in the post-publish follow-up panel to encourage the user to continue editing and improving their article.
articleguidance-publish-followup-close-b: Label for a close button used in the post-publish follow-up panel and other modals in the Article Guidance workflow.
articleguidance-unsupported-subject-head: Heading shown in the unsupported subject step, displayed when the user selects a Wikidata item that has no matching outline.
articleguidance-unsupported-subject-requ: Title of the 'request support' option in the unsupported subject step. Clicking opens the Article Guidance talk page to request a new outline.
Description of the 'request support' option in the unsupported subject step.
articleguidance-unsupported-subject-star: Title of the 'start writing' option in the unsupported subject step. Clicking opens VisualEditor for the article title without guidance.
Description of the 'start writing' option in the unsupported subject step.
